run: the ezafe tagger without spaCy: does src/voiceclone/text/ezafe_tagger.py give hazm's ParsBERT tagger's decisions
status: registered 2026-10-03, before the export ran or the light tagger tagged anything
why: as published the tagger is a spaCy pipeline that peaked at 4.3 GB (peak memory footprint, /usr/bin/time -l) and took 13.5 s for one sentence on the M1 Pro, most of it importing spaCy and loading through spacy-transformers; that cannot run beside a loaded OmniVoice on this 16 GB Mac. The light tagger runs the same tensors with transformers alone

what_is_compared.ezafe: per word, the ezafe decision (a tag carrying ,EZ) against the spaCy pipeline's recorded decisions: eval/runs/evidence/frontend-components-v1/predictions-hazm-spacy-sentencebench.json (400 sentences) and predictions-hazm-spacy-review14.json (14), same tokens (scripts/measure_frontend_components.py tagger_tokens)
what_is_compared.tags: per token, the full tag, against the tags recorded for the 12 listening sentences in eval/runs/frontend-listening-v1/texts.json
what_is_compared.not_re_run: the spaCy pipeline is not run again: its recorded outputs are the reference, so the Mac does not carry a 4 GB load for this

criterion: adopted only if every ezafe decision on the 414 sentences and every tag on the 12 agree. Any disagreement: not adopted as it stands; each one is looked at and reported
cost: on this Mac, CPU: the export reads the 655 MB pipeline file once; peak memory and time of the light tagger are measured and reported

result.agree: every one: 3,156 ezafe decisions on SentenceBench's 400 sentences, 199 on the review's 14, 147 tags on the 12 listening sentences - the criterion is met and the light tagger is adopted
result.cost: the light tagger loads in 3.5 s from disk (0.3 s when cached), tags at about 30 ms a sentence, and peaks at 0.86 GB resident, 0.44 GB footprint (/usr/bin/time -l) - against the spaCy pipeline's 13.5 s and 4.3 GB footprint for one sentence. The one-time export took the process to 2.3 GB
result.export: ~/.cache/persian-voice-cloning/ezafe-tagger/eba1d2b30cc4 (624 MB): ParsBERT's config, tokenizer and weights and the output layer, read out of the pipeline at the pinned revision, file hashes in the evidence

in_the_app.what: the light tagger behind the app's text pipeline for OmniVoice (src/voiceclone/text/ezafe_fa.py, text.ezafe and text.marks_engines in configs/default.yaml): loaded for one text and released, not started with under 1.5 GB available; a final h decided by the letter before it and a list of 33 words whose h is pronounced (marks_fa.PRONOUNCED_H, checked against KaamelDict, none of its data shipped: it is GPL); no ezafe on مدیر before عامل; the normaliser keeps أ and writes ۀ as هٔ for OmniVoice only
in_the_app.check: scripts/check_ezafe_in_app.py: the 12 listening sentences through the app at its default settings give the E text the user heard in 11, and in n12 differ only by the ezafe the rule now refuses on مدیر (eval/runs/evidence/ezafe-tagger-v1/app_vs_heard.json)
in_the_app.unchanged: every other engine gets the text it got before; the registered render scripts (scripts/ab_omnivoice_ipa.py render_config) turn both off, so a re-run feeds what the runs fed
